scope: All human-facing monetary output in Local Web and Public Web, including Staff and Guest surfaces
rules: human-facing monetary output must use an approved money formatter or explicit semantic amount-only moneyNumber formatter
money digits use Persian numerals and three-digit grouping with U+066C separator
full money strings include the تومان currency label unless the UI already provides an adjacent explicit تومان label
amount-only moneyNumber is permitted only where the same visual component provides the currency context
raw canonical numeric values remain permitted in API payloads, data attributes, storage, arithmetic and signed print-document schemas
quantities, percentages, identifiers, dates and durations are not money and must not be grouped under this contract
Guest and Guest-LAN price output must preserve the same grouping behavior
server-rendered search and notification money must use Persian grouped output
approved_php: dashboard money closures backed by grouped Persian digits
